recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下骨小樑之間幾乎 100% 被單調的未成熟細胞填滿，脂肪消失、正常三系造血的混合樣貌不見；這張圖能看出白血病浸潤，但放大倍率不足以判斷顆粒球成熟程度。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) with loss of fat between bony trabeculae
Diffuse sheets of intermediate-sized immature cells with pale to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Effacement of normal trilineage architecture; megakaryocytes not readily identified
Intact lamellar bony trabeculae without osteosclerosis
Cytologic detail (nucleoli, granules, maturing forms) not resolvable at this low magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow, approaching 100% cellularity, with near-complete loss of adipocytes. The intertrabecular spaces are diffusely replaced by sheets of intermediate-sized immature-appearing cells, with effacement of the normal trilineage hematopoietic pattern and inconspicuous megakaryocytes. Bony trabeculae appear unremarkable. The low magnification does not allow assessment of granulocytic maturation, so correlation with the aspirate differential is required; in that context the findings are consistent with involvement by acute myeloid leukemia, reported as AML with maturation.

ddx.vs: Cannot be separated on this low-power biopsy; the aspirate differential showing <10% versus >=10% maturing granulocytes decides.
Also produces a packed marrow, so lineage requires MPO/CD34/TdT immunostains or flow cytometry.
MDS retains trilineage hematopoiesis with dysplastic megakaryocytes and fewer than 20% blasts, rather than diffuse sheets of immature cells.
